findings.current: It was something only those who had come to know Jin Taekyung possessed.
findings.defect: “Come to know” weakens the source’s meaning of having personally experienced or gone through Jin Taekyung.
findings.rationale: The Korean 겪은 이들 refers to people who have experienced Jin firsthand, not merely people who became acquainted with him. The accepted baseline preserved that stronger sense.
findings.replacement: It was something only those who had experienced Jin Taekyung possessed.

summary: The assembled chapter is broadly faithful. One minor relationship nuance is weakened in the discussion of what Jin Taekyung gives those who encounter him.
